engine_evidence.observed: 21-joint procedural humanoid plus weapon socket; stylized primitive body; Shadowblade clip set
Toon/Lit/Unlit/Water shading models; toon shade threshold/softness, hard specular, rim, outline
procedural character is actually drawn with toon, rim, emissive accents, blade, afterimages, trails and guard bubble
runtime canvas exists, but this task does not add character UI or change engine code

baseline.claim_boundary: Source/art-direction acceptance only. Current procedural humanoid proves an in-engine fixture path exists; it is not a production protagonist, DCC import pipeline, retargeting solution, or art approval.

product_identity.setting: original supernatural modern Washington, DC National Mall action RPG
product_identity.protagonist_policy: one persistent customizable protagonist, with masculine/feminine body-presentation variants sharing identity, rig intent and equipment language; no collectible-character roster expansion
product_identity.protected_reference_policy: Genshin Impact and Zenless Zone Zero are quality/readability references only; no protected characters, costumes, logos, maps, textures, music, models or proprietary content may be copied

reference_evidence.source: Unreal Engine 5.8 Creating and Using LODs
reference_evidence.lesson: LOD transitions are evaluated by screen size, so silhouette/readability review should use apparent screen size rather than distance alone.
important structures can be prioritized through reduction; Astral art QA should identify silhouette-critical structures before any future simplification.
screen-relative height is an explicit LOD transition input, reinforcing screen-space review fixtures.

review_fixture.lighting: neutral fixed key/fill/rim; no dramatic fog, bloom or class VFX during base silhouette scoring
review_fixture.camera: fixed perspective and framing per review size; record FOV and resolution in runtime receipts
review_fixture.notes: Pixel thresholds below are proposed authoring QA values. They become approved only after native Astral captures and independent art review.

must_read_at_96px: head/hair mass separates from shoulders in front and three-quarter views
both hands remain locatable in action poses unless intentionally occluded by the held equipment
weapon/focus/guard primary shape does not collapse into the torso silhouette
at least one negative-space channel separates arm/equipment from torso on each action pose
lower legs do not merge into one column in neutral, walk-contact and guard/cast poses
silhouette_rules.failure_rule: A class read that depends on glow, hue, particles, UI labels or camera motion fails the base silhouette pass.

anatomy_and_variant_rules.shared_identity: masculine/feminine variants must be recognizable as the same protagonist rather than separate gacha-style characters
may_vary: voice/presentation choices outside this art packet
anatomy_and_variant_rules.deformation_gate: No proportion variant is production-ready until bind/rest pose, shoulder/hip deformation, hands, knees and extreme combat poses are checked in the actual accepted rig.

global_hierarchy: large dark/neutral base masses establish the body silhouette
one secondary mid-value costume family groups torso/coat structure
small emissive/mana accents identify supernatural state but never carry class identity alone
metal/hard-surface highlights are restrained so skin, face and equipment focal areas remain readable
costume_material_language.material_identity: Separate cloth, leather/rubber-like soft hardwear, metal, skin/hair and supernatural emissive response by value/specular/rim behavior as well as hue.

current_astral_mapping.skin_hair: Toon, opaque, outline on; tune shadeColor/threshold independently when supported by actual material ownership
current_astral_mapping.metal_equipment: Toon or Lit only after matched in-engine comparison; do not assume PBR parity
current_astral_mapping.mana_glow: Unlit/emissive additive only for accents; not a substitute for silhouette/value design

hair_eye_skin_rules.hair: Use 2-4 readable clump masses before strand detail; preserve head profile at 64 px; avoid fringe that erases both eyes in normal gameplay angles.
hair_eye_skin_rules.eyes: Eye shape must survive 128 px review without relying on emissive glow; eye color is secondary to shape/value.
hair_eye_skin_rules.skin: Keep face/hand value separation from adjacent hair/gloves/collar under both light and dark outdoor conditions; exact palette remains proposed until neutral-light runtime captures exist.
hair_eye_skin_rules.outline: Outline must not close critical eye/mouth/hand gaps at the primary review size; no fixed pixel width is approved until native Astral capture measures the current renderer.

Shadowblade.shape_language: forward diagonal and tapered blade lane; asymmetry around weapon side; coat/scarf motion supports direction without obscuring feet
Shadowblade.pose_read: windup and dash direction readable with trail/afterimage disabled

Arc Mage.shape_language: open upper-body silhouette and visible casting hand/focus separation; avoid oversized floating ornament clutter
Arc Mage.primary_equipment: compact focus or catalyst close enough to animate reliably but separated from hand/torso silhouette
Arc Mage.pose_read: cast direction readable from hands/torso before mana VFX

Aegis.shape_language: broader defensive forearm/guard mass and grounded stance; preserve head and weapon-side hand visibility
Aegis.primary_equipment: guard/shield-like protection family, final form pending gameplay/art approval
Aegis.pose_read: defensive orientation readable without shield glow or UI

toon_lighting_and_effect_rules.base_value_bands: Design for at least three perceived value groups in neutral review: lit/focal, local mid, shadow/base. This is an art test, not a demand for exactly three shader bands.
toon_lighting_and_effect_rules.rim: Rim is reinforcement, not silhouette ownership; base silhouette must pass with rim disabled.
toon_lighting_and_effect_rules.outline: Ink outline is part of the look, but acceptance compares outline-on and outline-off to detect collapsed internal gaps.
toon_lighting_and_effect_rules.effects: Trails, afterimages, particles and bloom must clear face, hands, feet and target contact for at least one readable frame around gameplay-critical timing.
toon_lighting_and_effect_rules.hit_flash: Hit feedback may temporarily override palette, but it must not destroy pose/target readability.

runtime_capture_requirements: use current Astral renderer, not offline Blender or generated stills, for runtime claims
capture all four review views at 64/96/128 px apparent body height against all three neutral backgrounds
capture base look with VFX off, rim off/on and outline off/on where the renderer exposes those toggles
record exact commit, resolution, FOV, camera transform, look/material parameters and capture hash
repeat neutral, locomotion and one archetype action pose
independent reviewer scores silhouette, pose, focal hierarchy, internal-gap preservation and class read before art_approved
